title: OL-20261115-12: Close or record the open workers issues and stop Q-GROW-second-tenant being re-filed after merge
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** daily clock
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/OL-20261115-12.json::Status
**Status:** open

workers issues 13, 19, 73, 75, 166, 173, 181, 183 were open at 2026-11-15. 173, 181, 183 were being worked by the issues-remediation session; 166, 75, 73 are identity-bound (owner Cloudflare account) with the staged default in effect; 13 and 19 are untriaged. Q-GROW-second-tenant-deploying was re-filed and merged four times (348, 379, 385, 389): find why the lane re-queues it after merge. Session branch deletes return 403; merged-branch cleanup relies on GitHub auto-delete.
